title: Data on Companies with More Than 25 Workers Paying Retrenchment Benefits in Line with Tripartite Guidelines
what_it_is: Data on Companies with More Than 25 Workers Paying Retrenchment Benefits in Line with Tripartite Guidelines

sections.label: Retrenchment benefits received by employees
sections.summary: From 2020 to 2025, around nine in 10 eligible employees received retrenchment benefits, and around eight in 10 received at least two weeks' salary per year of service.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Based on Mandatory Retrenchment Notification (MRN) data submitted by companies with 10 or more employees, around nine in 10 eligible employees received retrenchment benefits from 2020 to 2025.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Among them, around eight in 10 received retrenchment benefits of at least two weeks’ salary per year of service, in line with the norms stated in the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Excess Manpower and Responsible Retrenchment (TAMEM).

sections.label: Mandatory retrenchment notification requirement
sections.summary: Companies retrenching five or more workers must notify MOM, and this requirement is not specific to company size.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: At this moment, our requirement for mandatory retrenchment is for companies that retrench five or more workers to notify MOM – and not specific to company size per se.

sections.label: Tripartite deliberation on retrenchment benefits
sections.summary: Tripartite partners deliberated minimum quantum and mandatory retrenchment benefits extensively and concluded a balanced approach protects workers while giving businesses flexibility.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, the questions of minimum quantum and mandatory retrenchment benefits have been deliberated extensively by the tripartite partners.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And we concluded that a balanced approach to protect workers, while at the same time providing businesses flexibility, would achieve better outcomes for both workers and businesses.

sections.label: Tripartite guidelines on retrenchment benefits
sections.summary: Tripartite partners agreed to issue guidelines stipulating prevailing norms for retrenchment benefit quantum, and most employees already receive benefits in line with these guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The tripartite partners agreed on a balanced approach to issue guidelines instead, which stipulate the prevailing norms for retrenchment benefit quantum and as mentioned in my reply, most employees today already receive retrenchment benefits in line with these tripartite guidelines.

sections.label: Unionised companies retrenchment benefit norm
sections.summary: For unionised companies with a collective agreement, the prevailing norm is one month per year of service.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In general, for unionised companies, if they have a collective agreement, the prevailing norm in unionised companies with a collective agreement is one month per year of service.

sections.label: Multinational companies retrenchment benefit caps
sections.summary: A supplementary question notes anecdotally that some multinational companies set retrenchment benefit caps lower than the TAMEM benchmark.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Just one supplementary question for the Senior Minister of State on retrenchment benefits payout.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I have noticed anecdotally some multinational companies set retrenchment benefit caps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: They are lower than the prescribed benchmark set in TAMEM.
